lessons_used: Evidence is still thin for all change types (sign_in hint, adoption redesign, finish new_screen, home wait_info, choose_path layout) as each has only one test.
Predictions were consistently too high across all tested changes compared to noise-corrected results.

candidates.title: Split-Screen Pet Trait Preview Layout
candidates.change: Redesign the pet selection screen into a split layout that showcases real-time personality traits and live animations alongside choice options.
candidates.why: Adoption step has a 39.1% drop-off rate and a high median time of 89s, indicating users struggle to compare pet options.

components.text: Select companion personality and visual style

guard.reason: Valid redesign of the pick_friend screen layout.

candidates.score_note: Targets highest drop-off step (39.1%); prior adoption redesign test yielded +1.9% lift.

candidates.title: Interactive Desktop Pet Quick Guide Screen
candidates.change: Add a dedicated visual guide screen right before completion detailing desktop shortcuts, drag behaviors, and pet interaction menus.
candidates.why: Support logs contain multiple reports of user confusion regarding how to control, hide, or talk to the pet following onboarding.

new_pet_quick_guide.headline: How to Interact with Your New Pet

components.text: Right-click pet anytime for main settings & companion commands
Click and drag to position your pet anywhere on screen

guard.reason: Valid addition of a quick guide screen inside onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Supported by funnel drop-off and support mail; finish new_screen test showed modest +0.9% lift.

candidates.title: Real-Time Photo Rendering Preview Flow
candidates.change: Introduce an instant visual rendering feedback preview when users upload custom pet photos before proceeding.
candidates.why: Support received reports where custom pet creation failed or resulted in distorted renderings after photo uploads.

upload_photos.headline: Instant Pet Preview
upload_photos.hint: Verify how your photo converts into a desktop companion

guard.reason: Valid visual preview enhancement to the upload_photos step.

candidates.score_note: Addresses high adoption drop-off and support reports, but requires significant visual dev.

candidates.title: Post-Adoption Account Save Reorder
candidates.change: Move sign-in step to occur after pet selection and certificate creation so users build emotional ownership before account creation.
candidates.why: Sign-in drop-off is 23.1%; asking users to sign in after customizing their pet leverages commitment bias and clarifies save state benefit.

sign_in.headline: Save Your Companion to Account
sign_in.hint: Linking your account ensures your pet is synced and safe from unexpected resets.

guard.reason: Valid reordering of sign_in step within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Addresses 23.1% sign-in drop-off via flow restructuring; sign-in area showed best past response.

candidates.title: Persistent Account Link Safety Hint
candidates.change: Display explicit hint text clarifying that logging in links your pet save state across re-installs.
candidates.why: The single largest support category (8 emails) concerned missing or reset pets after signing back in.

sign_in.hint: Sign in with your primary email to sync pet memory and prevent accidental profile resets.

guard.reason: text in 'sign_in.hint' asks for or mentions personal data

candidates.title: Pet Generation Time Estimate & Progress
candidates.change: Show live generation progress steps alongside an estimated countdown timer during pet synthesis.
candidates.why: The waiting screen has a high median duration of 201s and mean of 2336s, leading users to believe the process has frozen.

guard.reason: Valid time estimate and progress display on real wait screen.

candidates.score_note: Home wait_info category previously yielded +0.0% lift after noise correction.

candidates.title: Desktop Background Ready Desktop Notification
candidates.change: Enable desktop notification prompts on the waiting screen so users can safely minimize the app during long renders.
candidates.why: Extreme mean time on home screen (2336s) suggests users switch windows while waiting and miss when setup completes.

waiting.body: We will pop up a desktop notification as soon as your pet is ready to spawn!

guard.reason: Valid desktop notification toggle on waiting screen.

candidates.score_note: Targets extreme mean wait time (2336s) by supporting background multitasking.

candidates.title: Path Selection Choice Cards Layout
candidates.change: Organize onboarding path choices into prominent visual cards detailing estimated setup times and path outcomes.
candidates.why: Choose path has a drop-off rate of 23.8% and high mean duration (514s), indicating choice uncertainty.

components.text: Express Setup: Quick preset pet companion (2 mins)
Custom Creation: Unique pet from your photo (5 mins)

guard.reason: Valid redesign of choose_path retaining both adopt and custom paths.

candidates.score_note: Targets 23.8% drop-off; prior choose_path layout test yielded +1.2% lift.

candidates.title: Desktop Launch Permission Guidance Copy
candidates.change: Update finish headline and body text to clearly explain desktop overlay permission requirements and spawn actions.
candidates.why: Support mail reported issues where pets did not appear on the desktop overlay or app failed to open properly.

home_intro.headline: Your Pet is Ready to Spawn!
home_intro.body: Click Finish to launch your pet onto your screen overlay. Check system tray permissions if pet window does not immediately appear.

guard.reason: Valid copy update on home_intro screen.

candidates.score_note: Strong evidence from support mail and funnel; low-cost copy change to implement.

candidates.title: Story Screen Accessory Teaser Showcase
candidates.change: Add a prominent starter gift badge component on the intro story screen highlighting unlockable pet items.
candidates.why: Improving initial user excitement at step 1 helps decrease early drop-off (23.8% loss on choose_path).

guard.reason: Onboarding copy must not mention free extras or gifts.

picked: Interactive Desktop Pet Quick Guide Screen
lessons_next: Evidence is still thin for adoption redesign/new flow, finish new screen, home wait info/notification, and sign in hint changes as each has only one test.
Path selection layout changes (choose_path, layout) show a positive pattern across 2 tests (+1.2% and +5.6% after noise correction), with one test showing a clear winning effect.
Predictions were generally overly optimistic in Round 1, but underpredicted the Round 2 path layout winner.
